name: std::weak_ptr<T>::use_count
intro: Returns the number of shared_ptr instances that share ownership of the managed object, or 0 if the managed object has already been deleted, i.e. *this is empty.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of shared_ptr instances sharing the ownership of the managed object at the instant of the call.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The usage and behavior of this function are similar to std::shared_ptr::use_count, but it returns a different count.
